ui.vocal_separation.separate: Separate vocals and accompaniment first (recommended for songs)
ui.vocal_separation.enhance: Extra filtering of separated vocals (not a replacement for separation)
ui.vocal_separation.import_help: Songs use a real separation model before pitch and lyric analysis of the vocal stem. Disable separation only for already isolated vocals or clean test signals. Auditioning the input never changes the confirmed score.
ui.vocal_separation.preview_help: Auditioning unconfirmed stems does not replace the score or mapping. Closing restores previous playback only if the project and practice position are unchanged. Vocals may include harmonies; review the lead melody.
ui.vocal_separation.import_audition: Auditioning the input independently; the confirmed score and voice settings are unchanged.
ui.vocal_separation.preview_audition: Auditioning an unconfirmed stem without replacing the current score or source mapping.
ui.vocal_separation.no_stems: This project has no confirmed separated stems. Reimport the song with vocal separation enabled; the original mix was not substituted.
ui.vocal_separation.stem_mode_help: Playback uses the selected stem's source-audio clock. Melody mute and synthesized accompaniment mixing apply only to synthesized score playback.
messages.vocal_separation.missing_playba: The selected audio track is missing: %1. The previous playback source is retained; restore the file or separate again.
messages.storage.invalid_separation_fiel: Invalid separation metadata: status must be a boolean and paths and model must be bounded text. A separated result requires both stem paths and a model identifier.
messages.vocal_separation.invalid_manife: The separation manifest, audio verification or frame count is invalid; the result was not applied.
messages.vocal_separation.invalid_protoc: The separation worker returned invalid progress or result data.
messages.vocal_separation.missing_runtim: The local separation runtime, worker script or model is missing. Run setup-separation.ps1 to install them.
messages.vocal_separation.source_changed: The input audio changed during separation. Start the analysis again.
messages.vocal_separation.timeout: The vocal separation worker exceeded its wait limit; the result was not applied.
messages.audio_transcription.progress_se: Separating vocals and accompaniment with a neural model
messages.audio_transcription.separated_v: Pitch and lyrics were analyzed from vocals actually separated by a neural model. The vocal stem can still contain harmonies, bleed or separation artifacts, not only the lead singer. Audition and correct it.
messages.audio_transcription.separation_: Source audio, model and stems passed SHA and frame-count checks; verified separation cache was reused.
cli.input_isolated_vocals: Explicitly mark the input as already isolated vocals and skip separation
